methodology: Ten distinct ASA base candidates. Display order groups practical single-player/PvE choices; it is an editorial order, not a vote, raid guarantee or measured resource score. Coordinates retain creator precision. Layout advice is Codex planning inference; source evidence is identified per spot.
limits: Primary metadata confirms ASA video identity and exact chapter starts. Coordinates come from a third-party mirror of creator auto captions and remain provisional navigation pins. No in-game or visual GPS proof. Ten genuine 320×180 stills from exact ASA chapters are bundled and visually reviewed for terrain. Official wiki maps are contextual references and do not validate these footprints.
